name: GeoParametric3D
purpose: Native web CAD workstation manifest: Dual-route B-Rep pipeline, 100% opaque solid shading, 2,000-ft 1-ft ground grid, Fullerton geodetic origin anchor (33.8704 N, -117.9242 W, 1609.34 m MSL), and Vertex AI engineering assistant (broadcasterfishmap/global).

viewport.renderer: Google Maps 3D Web Component (<gmp-map-3d>) with WebGL/Canvas Overlay
viewport.coordinate_system: Geospatial WGS84 Geodetic & ENU Cartesian CAD

command_contracts.create_primitive: Creates a parametric CADObject and regenerates canonical faces.
command_contracts.set_property: Edits name, material, color, opacity, transform, or primitive parameters.
command_contracts.transform_object: Move, rotate, scale, duplicate selected body.
command_contracts.feature_extrude: Applies supported primitive dimension extrusion and records feature history.
command_contracts.feature_revolve: Records revolve feature definition in feature history.
command_contracts.feature_hole: Records hole definition in feature history.
command_contracts.feature_fillet: Records fillet definition in feature history.
command_contracts.feature_chamfer: Records chamfer definition in feature history.
command_contracts.feature_cross_sections: Records section-plane definition in feature history.
command_contracts.boolean_union: Records union between two selected bodies.
command_contracts.boolean_subtract: Records subtract and hides tool body.
command_contracts.boolean_intersect: Records intersection and hides tool body.
command_contracts.align_object: Aligns selected body to ground or document origin.
command_contracts.measure_selected: Returns bounds, volume, and mass data.

quality_gates: Direct geospatial throughput to Google Maps 3D Web Component (<gmp-map-3d>).
WGS84 Geodetic and Local Tangent Plane (ENU) Cartesian mapping engine.
Action-panel inputs are unit-aware and committed through the command gateway.
Boolean and advanced feature operations remain explicit in feature history until an exact solid-kernel adapter is connected.
